impact_scope.description: The existing get_quirk API changes from always returning 0 to reporting whether the existing IGNORE_CHECKSUM quirk is enabled, creating an observable set-then-get state protocol.
The return value now depends on the decoder's ignore_checksum state for base.QUIRK_IGNORE_CHECKSUM.

evidence: In S0, decoder.get_quirk always returns 0, so H0's omission of get_quirk does not miss any observable quirk-state behavior.
H0 already calls decoder.set_quirk! for WUFFS_BASE__QUIRK_IGNORE_CHECKSUM, exercising the existing configuration action relevant to decoding.
In S1, decoder.get_quirk returns 1 when queried with base.QUIRK_IGNORE_CHECKSUM after ignore_checksum has been enabled.
H0 sets the quirk but never calls decoder.get_quirk, so it cannot exercise or verify the newly observable enabled-state result.

new_harness_obligation.description: Exercise the new observable state protocol by calling decoder.get_quirk for QUIRK_IGNORE_CHECKSUM after configuring the quirk, with values that cover enabled and disabled state.
evidence: S1 adds a state-dependent branch and nonzero result to decoder.get_quirk that did not exist in S0.
Reaching the new result requires a concrete get_quirk call, and meaningful coverage includes the existing set_quirk!-then-get_quirk call order; H0 performs only the setter.

reason: For the stable scope of IGNORE_CHECKSUM quirk-state observation, S0 had no material omission because get_quirk exposed no state and always returned 0. S1 makes that existing API report mutable decoder state, while unchanged H0 never queries it. This creates a concrete new call and call-order obligation, so the harness gap is NEW.
